high_level_description: This image is a digital artwork featuring a silhouette of Lord Shiva, the Hindu deity, depicted in a meditative pose with his legs crossed and hands resting on his knees. The background is a dark, textured surface that gives a sense of depth and mystery. The central figure of Lord Shiva is composed of various elements: Trident (Trishul): A prominent feature of Lord Shiva, symbolizing his power and authority. Mountain Silhouette: The outline of mountains forms the body of the figure, adding to the spiritual and serene atmosphere. Sun: A bright orange sun is positioned behind the figure
